profile.headline: Software Engineer, Computer Scientist
profile.summary: I offer eight years of industry experience built on a foundational education from a globally-ranked university, an award-winning commitment to organized, scalable solutions, and a heartfelt passion for the field of computer science. Looking to acquire ever more skills and experiences in order to learn and grow in my capabilities as a software engineer.

positions.title: SR .NET Developer
positions.description: Initially worked in a maintenance role, patching and refactoring legacy applications at the direction of clients. Later switched to the mobile development team, creating full-stack solutions and implementing a department initiative to improve logging and telemetry capabilities.

positions.title: Research Programmer
positions.description: Dev-ops oriented role as a part of FPI's research department, where I helped financial professionals develop, test, and deploy various quantitative investment strategies, as well as other myriad solutions to aid in the team's efforts.
positions.insights: C#, Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) and +7 skills

positions.title: Depot Technician
positions.description: Student job processing and distributing hardware for the university's "Tech Depot." Received an ITS "Focus on Excellence Award" for creation and implementation of standardized auditing procedures for the purpose of identifying mismanaged inventory and reporting granular performance metrics.
positions.insights: Shell Scripting, Google Apps Script and +3 skills

honors.title: ITS Focus on Excellence Award
honors.description: An award for work efforts and results that are exceptional and beneficial to the organization.

projects.title: ELISE
projects.description: A re-implementation of the famous ELIZA program first described by Joseph Weizenbaum in "Communications of the ACM" in 1966. My version faithfully recreates the exact logic of the original, down to the Hollerith character encoding used to drive the "random" nature of certain responses.
